verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a first-party MCP server and an agent skill, so a user can drive its tools in natural language through an AI client. Its Answers endpoint also accepts a plain-language question or task. However, the natural-language layer comes from the external AI client rather than a native command interface, and the evidence never describes the end-to-end conversational experience. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations are reachable by natural language, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect your AI client to Context.dev tools for live web and company data.
